title: Going beyond the 4 main concepts of AI

cues.en: If you're seeing this video after completing all the previous sections of this course, I congratulate you, because now you have gained the knowledge
cues.zh: 如果你已經完成前面所有章節，恭喜你，因為現在已經掌握

cues.en: of the four main concepts of AI and C#, and in my opinion, are now able to make 90% of everything you need to do using AI apps.
cues.zh: C# AI 開發的四大核心概念。依我看，你已經能完成 AI 應用裡大約 90% 所需的工作。

cues.en: But there is more things to learn.
cues.zh: 但還有更多內容可以學，

cues.en: But beyond this point, it's less curated in which order you see things.
cues.zh: 而從現在起，觀看順序就沒有那麼嚴格。

cues.en: Up till now, it's been very important that you saw them in the order so you could gain the knowledge from the previous ones.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，依順序觀看很重要，因為需要用到前面的基礎知識。

cues.en: Now you can switch around, jump around to what you find interesting.
cues.zh: 現在可以自由跳到你感興趣的主題。

cues.en: There's four sections.
cues.zh: 接下來有四類章節。

cues.en: There's the advanced agent topics, where we go into some more nerdy things about reasoning, memory, telemetry, auditing, and such things.
cues.zh: 首先是代理程式進階主題，深入推理、記憶、遙測、稽核等比較技術性的內容。

cues.en: I would highly recommend you watch the reasoning part if you're using ChatGPT and OpenAI.
cues.zh: 如果使用 ChatGPT 和 OpenAI，我非常建議觀看推理相關影片。

cues.en: But beyond that, the topics are for you to use depending on what use cases you end up using.
cues.zh: 其餘主題則依實際使用情境，自行選擇需要的內容。

cues.en: The second part here is Agent Framework Toolkit, which is a set of NuGet packages that I have released that goes on top of
cues.zh: 第二部分是 Agent Framework Toolkit，這是我發布的一組 NuGet 套件，建立在

cues.en: the Agent Framework, and in my opinion, solves some of the more bumpy parts of the
cues.zh: Agent Framework 之上。我認為它解決了一些原本使用上比較不順手的地方，

cues.en: Agent Framework, like setting reasoning, doing tool calling together with middleware and such things.
cues.zh: 例如設定推理強度，以及搭配中介軟體進行工具呼叫等。

cues.en: It's much more discoverable, in my opinion.
cues.zh: 我覺得它的功能更容易發現，也比較好上手。

cues.en: So if you are interested in trying to get an even easier time with this tool, then go explore these videos that tells about
cues.zh: 如果想讓這套工具用起來更輕鬆，可以看看那些介紹

cues.en: these NuGet packages.
cues.zh: NuGet 套件的影片。

cues.en: Then there's the section about workflows.
cues.zh: 接著是工作流程章節。

cues.en: Workflows is the second part of the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 工作流程是 Microsoft Agent Framework 的第二大部分，

cues.en: Given the name, it's the secondary part and not the primary part.
cues.zh: 從框架名稱也能看出，它是次要部分，而不是主要核心。

cues.en: But workflows is the way where you can define multiple agents, chain them together, have human loops, fan in, fan out, and all these kinds of things that you can do with
cues.zh: 透過工作流程，可以定義多個代理程式並串接起來，加入人工介入、彙整、分散等各種

cues.en: workflows.
cues.zh: 流程控制。

cues.en: I'm personally not a big user of them.
cues.zh: 我個人沒有大量使用工作流程，

cues.en: I like to keep my own control and own control flow in the code, but they are doable if you wish to see them.
cues.zh: 比較喜歡在程式碼裡自己掌控控制流程，但你有興趣的話也能學習。

cues.en: Then there's bonus topics on various protocols, A2A, AGUI, and all kinds of tools, like DevUI
cues.zh: 最後還有補充主題，介紹 A2A、AG-UI 等協定，以及 DevUI

cues.en: and various nice-to-have information that will go here.
cues.zh: 等工具和其他實用資訊。

cues.en: And what I'm listing here is by no mean the full content of these four sections, because this is a living and evolving course,
cues.zh: 這裡列出的絕對不是這四類章節的完整內容，因為課程會持續演進，

cues.en: so I'll add more as we go along.
cues.zh: 我也會陸續新增。

cues.en: And, of course, you can ask for certain areas to be further explained and so on through the communication channels of this course.
cues.zh: 當然，你也可以透過課程的溝通管道，提出希望進一步解釋的主題。

cues.en: So now it's time for you to go explore beyond the main concepts, either to go out, build your first app, I highly recommend
cues.zh: 現在可以開始探索核心概念以外的內容，或先去建立自己的第一個應用程式，我很建議

cues.en: you go and try that, or go to the rest of the course topics.
cues.zh: 你親自試試，再回來繼續看其他主題。
